summary: The ClinicalPracticeCodes file defines a class that interacts with a database to manage clinical practice codes including operations such as adding, updating, deleting, and searching for codes. These operations are performed through stored procedures and involve validating inputs and managing database connections.
purpose: The purpose of the ClinicalPracticeCodes class is to provide a structured approach to managing clinical practice codes in a database, including validation of input data and executing database stored procedures for CRUD operations.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the Clinical Practice Code.

fields.name: ProgramID
fields.description: The ID of the program associated with the Clinical Practice Code.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the Clinical Practice Code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: The short name of the Clinical Practice Code.

fields.name: Inactive
fields.description: Indicates whether the Clinical Practice Code is inactive.

workflows.name: Update Clinical Practice Code
steps: Check if ID is not zero.

workflows.name: Delete Clinical Practice Code
steps: Check if ID is not zero.

workflows.name: Reactivate Clinical Practice Code
steps: Check if ID is not zero.

business_rules: A valid Clinical Practice Code must have both Name and ShortName specified.
The ID must be a non-zero value to perform update, delete, or reactivate operations.
validations: Check if Name is not blank.
Check if ShortName is not blank.
conditions: ID must be non-zero for update, delete, or reactivate operations.
system_behavior: System adds, updates, deletes, or reactivates Clinical Practice Codes through stored procedures.
System performs input validation before executing database operations.
Database connection is managed using HSPnetSession.
dependencies: Depends on stored procedures: ClinicalPracticeCodeAdd, ClinicalPracticeCodeUpdate, ClinicalPracticeCodeDelete, ClinicalPracticeCodeReactivate, ClinicalPracticeCodeSearchProgram, ClinicalPracticeCodeSearchStudent.
